headline: Parts of a long bone, labeled
stat_note: when the growth plate typically becomes an epiphyseal line
body:
Diaphysis: the shaft
Epiphysis: the wider spongy ends
Metaphysis: holds the growth plate
Articular cartilage: cuts friction
Periosteum: fibrous outer cover
source: Source: OpenStax Anatomy & Physiology 2e, 6.3 Bone Structure

headline: The cardiac cycle in order
stat_note: S1: AV valves close · S2: semilunar close
body:
1 Filling: AV valves open, atria add 20–30%
2 Isovolumic contraction: valves shut
3 Ejection: semilunar valves open
4 Isovolumic relaxation: they close
Systole = squeeze, diastole = relax
source: Source: OpenStax Anatomy & Physiology 2e, 19.3 Cardiac Cycle
